name: CKEditor Description List
description: Adds the Description list plugin to CKEditor.
project_description:
This module adds description list plugin into your WYSIWYG. It provides dl, dt and dd html tags.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 CKEditor v4 (not compatible v5)

Description list plugin : https://github.com/Reinmar/ckeditor-plugin-descriptionlist 

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 Download the plugin from https://github.com/Reinmar/ckeditor-plugin-descriptionlist 
 Place the plugin in the root libraries folder (/libraries/ckeditor-plugin-descriptionlist). 
 Install/Enable the CKEditor Description List module as you would normally

install a contributed Drupal module. 
 Configure your WYSIWYG toolbar to include description list buttons.
